content.text:
Created three files:

**`src/main/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocol.java`** — single UDP `EndpointListener` (datagram `true`), pipeline: `GlyphBoundaryFrameSplitter(MAX_FRAME_LENGTH, '$')` → `StringEncoder` → `StringDecoder` → decoder.

**`src/main/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocolDecoder.java`** — two `GrammarComposer` patterns; `@LINK` resolves the session and returns null, `@GPSD` builds a `Position` (date `YMD_HMS`, coordinates `WHOLE_DEG_HEMI`, speed via `UnitsConverter.nauticalFromMetricSpeed`, altitude, `KEY_BATTERY_LEVEL`, `KEY_LOCK` from `L/R`, `KEY_ALARM` when the flag is non-empty), and returns null when neither pattern matches.

**`src/test/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocolDecoderTest.java`** — `assertNoOutput` for the login frame, `assertFixDecoded` for the sample position, plus `verifyAttribute` checks for battery level, backlog (`S` record), and alarm.

Two decisions worth flagging:
- `KEY_ARCHIVE` doesn't exist in this repo; the `S` (stored) flag is set as `Position.KEY_BACKLOG` (`"archive"`), only when the record is stored.
- The alarm field is a free-form code with no documented value set, so it is stored raw under `KEY_ALARM` rather than mapped to invented `ALARM_*` constants.

I could not compile or run the test: `./gradlew test`/`checkstyle` and even a `python3` regex sanity check were blocked by the permission system in this session, and there is no approval surface here. The patterns and harness expectations were verified by reading `GrammarComposer`, `FieldCursor`, and `WireDecoderHarness`, but the files are unbuilt — please run `./gradlew test --tests org.traccar.protocol.R16hProtocolDecoderTest checkstyleMain checkstyleTest` to confirm.
